# laravelforge_org_recipe_run (Data Source)

Fetches a single Laravel Forge recipe run (log) by ID for a recipe in an organization.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the recipe run (log).
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `recipe` (Number) Numeric ID of the recipe.

### Read-Only

- `executed_by` (Number) ID of the user who executed the run.
- `finished_at` (String) Timestamp the run finished.
- `output` (String) Output captured from the run.
- `recipe_id` (Number) ID of the recipe that was run.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server the recipe ran on.
- `started_at` (String) Timestamp the run started.
- `status` (String) Run status (`waiting`, `running`, `finished`, `failed`).
